state: PROPOSED: not frozen until the operator approves them (D6). Nothing has been evaluated against them. Two pilot runs do not establish noise tolerance, so each limit is provisional until the Java sample and Task 5's first scale run.
basis: Limits sit about twice above the latest pilot, because latency moved up to 1.8 times between two runs of the same work on this machine. K2 keeps the earlier probe's bounds and scales only its size.

task_4_gates: Assembly's share of its budget and query fan-out are measured when assembly exists, and their limits are approved before Task 5.
First-file visibility in a real Zed session is shown there; the limit above is the worker's.

k2_second_run.concurrency: four concurrent clients through the real route, served by its two workers and queue of eight, with INDEX_BUSY counted and reported

reserve.enforcement: Nothing in the product enforces it. The run fails if used memory exceeds 3072 MB.

physical_ram_mb.why: the container's own limit: maxmemory plus 512 MB of headroom

retrieval: Recall, required-evidence, irrelevant-token and coverage targets are set from context-off and lexical baselines before the held-out set is opened, in Task 5, and need their own approval. No number is proposed here because nothing has measured them.
